observations: The page number «56» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02 end the example of p. 55 (JP2 0087, L31-L35); they are set flush right in a narrower measure, ending about 340 px before the right margin, the two figures one under the other; transcribed as lines set to the right. L06-L07: the heading of chapter 14, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L01-L05. Checked: 360° − 115° 10′ = 244° 50′; the anomaly of Saturn, 109° 24½′ (p. 55), is less than the first station, 115° 10′, so that Saturn was direct, as L03-L04 say. Note 1: the table is entered with 139°, the whole degrees of the centrum aequatum 139° 31½′. The value 115° 10′ is to be compared with Table 31.

N02-N05. Checked: with Brahmagupta's parameters (revolutions in 4 320 000 000 years of 1 577 916 450 000 days: the sun 4 320 000 000, Saturn 146 567 298, Jupiter 364 226 455, Mars 2 296 828 522, the conjunction of Venus 7 022 389 492 and of Mercury 17 936 998 984), the daily motion in anomaly, the difference from the sun's, is 57′ 7.8″ for Saturn, 54′ 9.0″ for Jupiter, 27′ 41.7″ for Mars, 36′ 59.6″ for Venus and 3° 6′ 24.1″ for Mercury: the five values of note 2 to the second. L08-L35: the time is the difference between the anomaly and a station divided by the daily motion in anomaly.

L19-L20: the sentence of chapter 14, p. 13 (JP2 0045, L03-L04), «deinde per argumentum ad hoc negotium proprium, quanto tempore illud transeat, coniectabitur», quoted with a capital D and without the note numbers of the edition, Suter's gloss «(d. i. hier = log. Schluss, Verfahren)» upright within it. N07: the sentence of p. 13 (JP2 0045, L08), «Quod si non procul a statione prima fuerit», with four points after it.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Nallino»; italics: «Statio prima», «Statio secunda», «Anomal. aeq.» (L03, L11-L12, L14-L15, L33; upright in L23 and L28-L29), «vorwärtsschreitend», «rechtläufig» (L04, L26), «rückläufig» (L10), «1. Fall», «kleiner» (L33), the Latin of L19-L20 and N07, «Heza» (N03).
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (7-13 px measured; «Weg :» 9 px, «1. Fall :» 9 px, «(p. 13) :» in N07 13 px).
